Author: Velvet Rope contributors
Name: Velvet Rope
Punchline: Venue profiles, VIP arrival alerts, and privacy-first shift reporting.
Description: A privacy-first venue door and VIP management plugin for FFXIV. Includes venue-specific VIP and staff relationships, tier benefits, Add Target, right-click tools, native nameplate markers, UI packs, and anonymous aggregate shift reports.
Changelog: 0.3.10 adds optional VIP tiering per venue relationship and neutral category nameplate markers for non-tiered staff, DJs, owners, partners, regulars, and other roles.
